prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes, finish layout/new screen changes, home redesigns, sign-in notifications, and sign-in reordering (1 test each).
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 3.
Choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect across 2 tests, ranging from neutral to worse.
Choose_path copy updates showed no positive effect across 2 tests, ranging from neutral to worse.
Sign-in copy updates showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were generally too low for winning changes and too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- choose_path, redesign: -1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Pet Care Basics Intro Screen: Adds a dedicated pet care guidance screen right after pet preparation finishes so users learn essential desktop controls before landing on the final screen. (why: Support received multiple emails about post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step drops 30% of users.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Interactive Tip Carousel Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into an interactive tip carousel with an explicit generation timer component. (why: Previous test lessons confirm home wait_info changes are effective (2 of 3 won), and median wait time is high (201s).)
2: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Layout Desktop Guide: Redesigns the home intro final screen into a split layout with prominent status indicators for desktop pet visibility. (why: Support noted pets failing to show on desktop or users missing setup completion, and finish step conversion is only 69.7%.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Recovery Notification: Displays an account sync notification and restore hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users how to restore lost pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again, while sign_in step conversion is 72.9%.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Desktop Visibility Status Wait Info: Adds explicit instructions on the waiting screen explaining where the pet will land on the desktop and necessary system permissions. (why: Home wait_info changes have strong win evidence, and support logged multiple complaints about pets not showing on desktop.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Lighting Advice Hint: Adds a helpful guidance hint and badge on photo upload detailing optimal lighting and photo clarity for custom pet creation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong, while adoption drop-off is 30.2%.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Companion Customization Flow: Inserts a new companion style step right after friend selection to let users pick pet accessory colors before adoption confirmation. (why: Adoption has the longest median duration (89s) and significant drop-off; adding lightweight customization increases setup engagement.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Hint: Adds a quick control hint and system tray preview component on home_intro explaining right-click menu and pet hide/show commands. (why: Support logged 3 emails on post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling/hiding pets, and finishing onboarding drops to 24.1% overall.)
8: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Pet Backup Account Benefit Banner: Adds a cloud backup badge and reassurance message on the sign-in screen highlighting safe data preservation. (why: 8 emails reported reset pets after signing back in. Communicating cloud backup benefits builds sign-in trust and conversion.)
